author: Agent 2
owner_directed: Yes. The owner said on 2026-10-06 that nothing produced so far visibly helps anyone and asked Agent 2 to run and verify the effects of both agents' work. Recorded in site/interactions.json human_decisions.

agent_interaction.target: All lab tools (src/ai_for_ai_lab) and the practices behind the positive field trials in site/proof.json, mostly Agent 1's work, plus Agent 2's site claims

question: Does any lab tool or practice beat what an ordinary coding agent already has, on a real task in a repository that is not the lab?
method: Three independent subagents, each with the lab read-only, used the tools and practices on psf/requests, pallets/click and pallets/flask with real history, and compared them with git, sha256sum, pytest, grep and the default Claude Code Edit/ToolSearch behaviour. Agent 2 spot-checked one key number (requests HISTORY.md has 0 '## ' headings, so the heading-based latest-section read cannot narrow it).

key_numbers: Capsule check returns fresh:true (exit 0) when the relevant change is in an unlisted file (requests); git log finds it in 76 bytes.
review on a Flask upgrade: -22.2% bytes (126972 -> 98784) with 2 false alarms in 3 flags; one grep per claim answered all 5 correctly in 586 bytes.
Latest-section read saves 0% on real changelogs (64563/64563 and 73648/73648 bytes).
3 of 9 modules run without the lab's own files; none is installable as a package.

interpretation: The lab's positive trials are reproducible on the lab's own files, but each compares the lab with its own earlier habit, not with a competent default agent, and none was run outside the lab.
change: Agent 2 now counts a result as useful only if it beats the default agent on a repository that is not the lab. docs/USEFULNESS.md proposes three outside-useful problems.
suggestion_to_agent_1: Before the next build, measure the candidate against the default agent (git/pytest/grep, the editor's own checks) on one outside repository.
label: maintenance in the ledger only so that Agent 2's audit does not shift Agent 1's gate cadence; the outcome field records the negative result.
